The '''Burning Ember''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] and feared military unit which served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict fought between the Confederacy and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="DV GP1" /> between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> During the war, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Gentis]] of the Republic, alongside seventy [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], went up against the Burning Ember division and emerged victorious.<ref name="DV GP1" />

Following the Clone Wars,<ref name="DV GP1" /> around 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="VaderDate">The various ''Darth Vader'' miniseries released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] date themselves to a few months after the events of {{Film|III}}, which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to early in the year [[19 BBY]], thus placing the ''Darth Vader'' comics, including ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]'', around 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]].</ref> [[Cadet/Legends|Cadet]] [[Laurita Tohm]] recollected the engagement of Gentis and the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] against the Burning Ember as the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] spoke to him and hundreds of other graduating [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] on<ref name="DV GP1" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="DV GP1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Burning Ember was mentioned in the [[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 1|first issue]] of the [[2012]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]''. The issue was written by [[W. Haden Blackman]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="DV GP1" /> on [[May 23]], 2012.<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54120/star_wars_darth_vader_and_the_ghost_prison_2012_1|text=Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison (2012) #1}}</ref>
